study.title: NextGen Cassava tricot trial in Nigeria, 2021-2022 (nextgencassNIG21)
study.description: On-farm tricot evaluation of NextGen Cassava clones developed by IITA since 2013, with local varieties and popular improved varieties as checks, in Osun, Benue, Akwa Ibom and Imo states. Farmers ranked the varieties at 1, 3, 6 and 9 months after planting, at harvest, during gari processing and for gari and eba quality. Coordinated by Béla Teeken (IITA), Samuel Onwuka (National Root Crops Research Institute), Abolore Bello (IITA), Tessy Madu (National Root Crops Research Institute). ClimMob randomisation with data collected on paper. Farmers also planted the best tricot plot from the previous year. Related publication in preparation (Teeken, de Sousa et al., NextGen Cassava tricot in Nigeria). Farmer and household covariates include education, civil status and indicators of the RHoMIS household survey of 2020 for the farmers who also took part in 2020.

location_privacy.method: Site coordinates rounded to two decimals (a cell of about 1.1 km), so the published point lies within 800 m of the recorded one and neighbouring sites share a point. Sites without coordinates take the mean of other sites in the same adm3 before rounding.
